product_overview: ABDEep is a web-based controller and patch editor for the DeepMind 12 synthesizer. It lets users shape sound, manage patches and banks, configure modulation and sequencing, and inspect calibration and diagnostic data from a single interface.
core_goals: Shape synth sound by adjusting oscillators, filters, envelopes, and performance controls
Create and edit modulation routings, arpeggiator patterns, and sequencer steps
Load, browse, and manage patch banks and individual patches
Configure global MIDI, routing, tuning, and UI preferences
Apply and tweak global multi-effects for patch sound design
Inspect calibration and diagnostic snapshots for the synth engine

features.name: Synthesizer Main Panel
features.description: Provides the main sound-design surface for controlling oscillator, filter, amplifier, modulation, and envelope parameters, while also showing visual feedback from analyzers.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Interact with synth sliders and knobs -> Toggle oscillator shapes -> Observe oscilloscope and spectrum analyzer displays
Navigate to / -> Adjust synthesis controls -> Review the resulting sound-shaping changes across oscillator, filter, and envelope sections

features.name: Modulation Matrix Modal
features.description: Lets users map modulation sources to synthesis destinations and set modulation depth for flexible sound routing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Modulation Matrix modal -> Adjust modulation depth and source-destination routing -> Close modal
Navigate to / -> Open Modulation Matrix modal -> Change routing assignments -> Review the updated modulation configuration -> Close modal

features.name: Bank and Patch Manager Modal
features.description: Allows users to browse preset, user, and hardware banks, load patches, and organize stored sounds.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Bank Manager modal -> Browse patch banks -> Select a patch load action -> See the chosen patch become active -> Close Bank Manager modal
Navigate to / -> Open Bank Manager modal -> Browse preset banks -> Browse user banks -> Browse hardware banks -> Close Bank Manager modal

features.name: Arpeggiator and Sequencer Modals
features.description: Provides controls for arpeggiator timing and pattern behavior, plus a 32-step polyphonic sequencer editor for step-by-step pattern creation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Arpeggiator modal -> Change rate, octaves, and pattern direction -> Close modal
Navigate to / -> Open Sequencer modal -> Edit step notes and gates -> Close modal
Navigate to / -> Open Arpeggiator modal -> Adjust arpeggiator behavior -> Open Sequencer modal -> Edit sequence steps -> Close modals

features.name: FX Modal Processor
features.description: Gives access to four global multi-effects slots, including algorithm selection and parameter editing for each slot.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open FX modal -> Select FX algorithms for Slots 1-4 -> Adjust FX parameters -> Close FX modal
Navigate to / -> Open FX modal -> Change one or more effect algorithms -> Fine-tune effect parameters -> Close FX modal

features.name: Calibration Lab
features.description: Shows diagnostic and calibration snapshots so users can inspect patch differences, raw data, engine output, and effective values.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Calibration Lab page -> Switch diagnostic tabs -> Refresh diagnostic snapshots -> Close Calibration Lab page
Navigate to / -> Open Calibration Lab page -> Switch between PatchDiff, Raw, Engine, and Effective views -> Review diagnostic output -> Close Calibration Lab page

features.name: Settings Modal
features.description: Lets users configure MIDI connection behavior, routing, global tuning, and UI theme preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Settings modal -> Switch between Connection, Routing, Misc, and Global tabs -> Change UI Theme or Master Tuning -> Close Settings modal
Navigate to / -> Open Settings modal -> Review MIDI connection settings -> Adjust routing preferences -> Change global tuning preferences -> Close Settings modal
